attempts.text:
**The window starts in a long persistent stretch.** Columns 0 to 24 are spine, carried by 95 to 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 5% of calls. The model names 95 to 100% of genes there, and no column hesitates more than 0.17 bits; the fewest named is `yhbW` at column 10, 95%.

**Then the graph opens at columns 25 to 43**, fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 41 to 92% of calls. The model names 89 to 98% of genes, and its hesitation peaks at column 26, `yraJ`, 0.93 bits, named 89%. The variable columns 25 to 30 carry `yraK` to `agaD` at 55 to 87%, then the `aga` columns 32 to 43 at 79 to 89%, [[PTS sugar transport]].

**A short spine follows**, columns 44 to 48, `garD` to `garK`, carried by 91 to 96% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 2 to 6% of calls, [[galactarate catabolism]]. The model names 92 to 96% of genes, fewest at `garK`, 92%, 0.40 bits. Columns 49 and 50 are variable, named 85 to 93%.

**The `tdc` and `cyu` spine runs from column 51 to 63**, carried by 93 to 95% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 1 to 2% of calls. The model names 74 to 94% of genes, fewest at `cyuP`, 74%; most hesitant at `tdcR`, 0.25 bits. Column 64 is variable, named 76%.

**The window ends in a spine and a fork.** Columns 65 to 76, `yhaH` to `exuT`, are carried by 90 to 96% of chromosomes, named 91 to 98%. Columns 77 to 79 are fork: `uxaC` at 87%, `uxaA` at 84%, `ygjV` at 78%, [[glucuronate catabolism]]. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 0.39 against 0.13 bits, and names fewer genes, 91% against 96%.

label: nusA
facts:
WINDOW: the nusA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor nusA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 535 to 614 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying nusA once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.18 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 32,475 calls, named 98%, 0.09 bits; shell 10,517 calls, named 86%, 0.42 bits; cloud 128 calls, named 12%, 3.76 bits. Outside an RGP 34,071 calls, named 96%, 0.13 bits; inside an RGP 9,049 calls, named 91%, 0.39 bits. Columns: 55 spine, 4 fork, 21 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.39 against 0.13 bits) and names fewer genes (91% against 96%); 9,049 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 26 (yraJ) 0.93 bits, RGP 89%; column 27 (yraI) 0.73 bits, RGP 92%; column 25 (yraK) 0.72 bits, RGP 87%. The 18 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 95%, 0.32 bits on average; the other 62 columns: named 95%, 0.14 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: columns 25-43 (fork and variable columns), RGP 41-92%; the least: columns 0-24 (spine), RGP 0-5%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-24 (25 columns) spine: share 95-100%, all P, RGP 0-5%. Genes: nusA, infB, rbfA, truB, rpsO, pnp, nlpI, yrbN "protein YrbN", deaD, mtr, yhbW "MsnO8 family LLM class oxidoreducta…", ubiV "U32 family peptidase", ubiU, ubiT, yhbS "GNAT family N-acetyltransferase", yhbQ "DNA damage response exodeoxyribonuc…", yhbP "YhbP family protein", yhbO "protein/nucleic acid deglycase", yraR "NAD(P)H-binding protein", yraQ "permease", dolP, diaA, yraN "YraN family protein", lpoA, rsmI. named 95-100% (mean 99%), fewest named at column 10 (yhbW), named 95%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.17 bits (column 10 (yhbW)).
2. columns 25-43 (19 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 41-92%. named 89-98% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 26, named 89%, 0.93 bits.
   columns 25-30 variable, share 55-87%, all S: yraK "fimbrial protein" 60%, yraJ "FimD/PapC N-terminal domain-contain…" 55%, yraI "molecular chaperone" 55%, yraH "fimbrial protein" 55%, agaI 87%, agaD 86%
   31 fork: agaC S 83% "PTS sugar transporter subunit IIC"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 23%
   columns 32-43 variable, share 79-89%, all S: agaB 87%, kbaY 88%, agaS 89%, nagA 85%, agaF "PTS galactosamine/N-acetylgalactosa…" 88%, agaE 87%, agaW 88%, agaV 88%, kbaZ 88%, agaR 89%, yhaV "type II toxin-antitoxin system ribo…" 79%, prlF 88%
3. columns 44-48 (5 columns) spine: share 91-96%, all P, RGP 2-6%. Genes: garD, garP "galactarate/glucarate/glycerate tra…", garL, garR, garK. named 92-96% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 48 (garK), named 92%, 0.40 bits.
4. columns 49-50 (2 columns) variable: RGP 2%. named 85-93% (mean 89%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 49, named 85%, 0.71 bits.
   49: yhaC S 59%
   50: yhaB S 73% "protein YhaB"
5. columns 51-63 (13 columns) spine: share 93-95%, all P, RGP 1-2%. Genes: tdcR, tdcA, tdcB "bifunctional threonine ammonia-lyas…", tdcC, tdcD, tdcE, tdcF, tdcG, cyuP, cyuA "serine dehydratase subunit alpha fa…", yhaL "protein YhaL", yhaK "pirin family protein", yhaJ "LysR family transcriptional regulat…". named 74-94% (mean 88%), fewest named at column 59 (cyuP), named 74%; most hesitant at column 51 (tdcR), 0.25 bits.
6. column 64 variable: RGP 1%. named 76%; 0.16 bits.
   64: yhaI S 79% "DUF805 domain-containing protein"
7. columns 65-76 (12 columns) spine: share 90-96%, all P, RGP 1-11%. Genes: yhaH "DUF805 domain-containing protein", yqjG "glutathionyl-hydroquinone reductase…", yqjF "DoxX family protein", yqjK "YqjK-like family protein", yqjE "phage holin family protein", yqjD "YqjD family protein", yqjC "DUF1090 family protein YqjC", mzrA, yqjA "DedA family general envelope mainte…", yqiM "protein YqiM", exuR, exuT "MFS transporter". named 91-98% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 75 (exuR), named 91%, 0.26 bits.
8. columns 77-79 (3 columns) fork: RGP 4-9%. named 93-96% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 77, named 93%, 0.22 bits.
   77: uxaC P 87% "glucuronate isomerase"; also rlmG P 19%, "hypothetical protein" S 18%, fadH P 12%
   78: uxaA P 84%; also ygjR P 36%
   79: ygjV P 78% "YgjV family protein"; also sstT P 57%, alx P 46%, ygjQ P 29%
